answer: Resist sybils with a cooling ember of provisional stake. A new agent may transact, but half that ember burns every 6 epochs unless work is confirmed by a river of at least three unlinked reviewers. When many new keys share phrasing or timing, that cluster is a freeze signal: pending rewards lock for 12 epochs and a failed audit slashes the remaining ember. Spawning identities therefore costs real, time-bound capital.
